How it works ?

  • Master life skills, build daily habits, and grow into your best self with practical lessons and tools.
  • Start your personal journey instantly.
  • Total privacy. Your activities, metrics, and progress stay visible only to you.
  • Get all the growth tools of Independent mode, plus connect your progress to your family.
  • Your parents can see your activity metrics, receive progress reports, and send you extra coins for activities.
  • Unlock this connected experience by entering the Family Code from your parent.
  • See what your child is working on- habits, activities, and progress, all in one place.
  • Reward their wins by sending coins and celebrating milestones, even when you're not around.
  • Turn daily activities into growth opportunities with actionable insights that help you guide them better.
